actions.description: Fence failed primary and atomically promote replica
actions.command:
set -eu
state=/var/lib/failover
if [ ! -e "$state/primary.failed" ]; then echo 'refusing promotion: primary.failed is missing' >&2; exit 1; fi
if ss -ltnH | awk '$4 ~ /(^|:)8081$/ { found=1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }'; then
  echo 'refusing promotion: old primary is still listening on 8081' >&2
  exit 1
fi
python - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

state = Path('/var/lib/failover')
failed = state / 'primary.failed'
fenced = state / 'primary.fenced'
role = state / 'replica.role'
upstream = state / 'upstream'

if not failed.exists():
    raise SystemExit('primary.failed disappeared')
